content_data.project_title: Regional Media Brand Consolidation & Visual Identity Optimization
content_data.project_description: Comprehensive design strategy to streamline visual assets and reduce production costs across regional media properties while maintaining brand consistency and audience engagement.
content_data.timeline: 14 months with Phase 1 (months 1-4), Phase 2 (months 5-10), and Phase 3 (months 11-14)
objectives: Develop cost-efficient design systems that maintain quality while reducing external agency spend
Reduce annual design production costs by consolidating visual systems across regional properties
deliverables: Asset management system with categorized, reusable design elements
Comprehensive visual identity audit across all regional media properties
Production workflow documentation with cost-saving recommendations
Consolidated brand style guide with modular design components
inspiration_references: BBC Design System - modular approach to large-scale media branding
Spotify's dynamic visual identity framework for content diversity
Google Material Design principles for systematic component libraries
technical_specs: Export templates for major social media platforms and advertising networks

memory_deletes.removed_item: Optimize asset management workflows to eliminate redundant creative production
Web-optimized SVG formats for scalable digital applications
